title: Plynth export options, version 4
description: The export-options.json file in a project folder (core/include/plynth/core/ExportGroups.h): the user's edits to the automatic export groups, the license report switch and the settings of each engine link. Version 1 files (export-options.v1.schema.json) had no gameplay switch and read with it off. Version 2 files (export-options.v2.schema.json) had no license switch and read with it off. Version 3 files (export-options.v3.schema.json) had the kit and gameplay switches at the top; they read as links.unreal.kit and links.unreal.gameplay. It is only there once something was changed. Edits refer to group ids and plan ids; one that no longer applies is skipped with a note at export time.

groups.description: Applied in this order: added, merges, moves, renames.

added.description: Groups the user made. They start empty.

id.description: group_ and eight characters as plan ids have, or group_ and a number from before.

merges.description: group goes away and its members join into.

id.description: The plan id, or null for the member that takes every object of the kind.

enabled.description: Also write the license report of the last build with every export and every link delivery.

links.description: The settings of each engine link, by link id. A link that is not listed has the defaults.

pack_materials.description: Send the materials and textures as ready material assets on the meshes. false: meshes only.

grouped.description: Send the groups of the grouped export as separate assets placed in the level. false: one building asset. null: follow the project's export mode.

gameplay.description: Also send the gameplay data file (rooms, doors and lights).

sync_after_build.description: Update the building in the target editor after every successful build while that editor is open.

target.description: The editor project the building was last delivered into. null before the first delivery.

groupName.description: English only: A to Z, a to z, 0 to 9, spaces, hyphens and underscores, with at least one letter or digit.
